title: qxmd295: website NTA = Quizrr; app MARKS player; fixed toolbar; Q+sol wrap; AI Proctor on toggle
body: Website NTA FORMAT is the Quizrr CBT (Accessibility, Screen Magnifier, Instructions, Question Paper). App NTA and QUANTREX keep the MARKS photo player with a pinned bottom toolbar. Question and solution math wrap without breaking. AI Proctor runs on every test mode only after the toggle is ON. Default remains off. Tab-switch shows a warning; it never auto-terminates.
